_note: The customer-facing structure of each collection's dataset: what one row is, and the columns a subscriber sees with a plain-English label and meaning. Written 2026-09-05 and kept in step with data/cedar/field_map.json, the field-by-field map behind the owner's exact column specification: every column here is one the map ships, under the name the map gives it (`rename_to`), one the writer builds at write time (`add`), or a combine's source shown until the combined column exists (`combine_into`); the first four (or, for Legislation and NAGPRA, five) are the specification's opening block. Meanings are read from the column names and ten rows of values and are to be confirmed by the terminal against the build scripts. Columns not listed stay in the workspace. The viewer reads this file: labels become headings, meanings become the record's definitions, and unlisted columns fold under Technical fields.

funding/federal_funding_transactions.row: One federal assistance transaction (a grant, loan, direct payment or insurance action) reported on USAspending, linked to the Native entity that received it.
funding/federal_funding_transactions.where: workspace dist/customer/funding.csv (the customer file, written by code/1137_customer_dataset_combine.py); the review copy is dist/review/spreadsheets/funding/federal_funding_transactions.csv; built by code/1135_full_dataset_review_bundle.py from the USAspending assistance archive.

fields.label: Cedar ID
fields.meaning: Cedar's permanent identifier for the canonical Native entity this record is associated with. The join key across every collection; never the record's own ID.

fields.label: Native entity
fields.meaning: That entity's name as Cedar's register spells it, so one entity reads the same in every collection. The record's own names (recipient, contractor, organization) stay in their own columns.

fields.label: Entity type
fields.meaning: Which of Cedar's eighteen classes the entity is (federally recognized tribe, Alaska Native village, ANCSA corporation, Native nonprofit, and so on), from the register.

fields.label: Entity role
fields.meaning: Why the entity is on this row: recipient.

fields.label: Transaction ID
fields.meaning: USAspending's unique key for this transaction. Cite it to find the exact record.

fields.label: Award ID
fields.meaning: USAspending's key for the whole award; the source link is built from it.

fields.label: Award number
fields.meaning: The award's Federal Award Identification Number; several transactions can share one.

fields.label: Action date
fields.meaning: The date the agency took this action.

fields.label: Fiscal year
fields.meaning: The federal fiscal year of the action (October to September), which is what USAspending reports and what the year filter uses.

fields.label: Partial fiscal year
fields.meaning: Whether this row falls in a fiscal year the source had not finished reporting when Cedar pulled it (yes or no). Do not compare a partial year to a complete one.

fields.label: Recipient as recorded
fields.meaning: The recipient's name as the award records it, before Cedar resolved it to the entity.

fields.label: Recipient UEI
fields.meaning: The recipient's federal Unique Entity ID.

fields.label: Business types code
fields.meaning: One of three overlapping recipient-type fields, consolidated through the source-code dictionary with conflict checks.

fields.label: Recipient type as recorded
fields.meaning: How USAspending classifies the recipient (for example, federally recognized tribal government).

fields.label: Business types description normalized
fields.meaning: The normalized spelling, the third of the three.

fields.label: Assistance type code
fields.meaning: The source's code for the assistance type (grant, loan, direct payment, insurance), defined in the dictionary; the readable type is beside it.

fields.label: Assistance type
fields.meaning: What kind of assistance it is: formula grant, project grant, direct payment, loan, insurance.

fields.label: Program number
fields.meaning: The Assistance Listing (CFDA) number of the federal program.

fields.label: Program
fields.meaning: The federal program's name.

fields.label: Agency
fields.meaning: The department that made the award.

fields.label: Office
fields.meaning: The office within the department.

fields.label: Amount obligated
fields.meaning: Dollars obligated by this transaction. Negative values are de-obligations, kept as recorded.

fields.label: Amount in 2025 dollars
fields.meaning: The same amount adjusted for inflation to 2025 dollars.

fields.label: Loan face value
fields.meaning: For loans, the face value of this loan; zero for grants.

fields.label: Original loan subsidy cost
fields.meaning: For a loan, the government's estimated cost of the subsidy when it was made. A loan measure; never added to obligations.

fields.label: Award loan face value
fields.meaning: For loans, the face value of the whole award to date.

fields.label: Total loan subsidy cost
fields.meaning: The subsidy cost across the award's loan actions. Never added to obligations.

fields.label: Recipient city
fields.meaning: City of the recipient's address on the award.

fields.label: Recipient state
fields.meaning: State of the recipient's address on the award.

fields.label: Recipient county
fields.meaning: The county of the recipient's address, which is not necessarily where the funded work happens.

fields.label: Recipient county FIPS
fields.meaning: The county code of the recipient's address.

fields.label: Place of performance county
fields.meaning: The county where the funded work is performed, as the award reports it.

fields.label: Place of performance county FIPS
fields.meaning: The county code where the funded work is performed, as the award reports it.

fields.label: Recipient geography status
fields.meaning: Whether the recipient's address was placed in a county: placed, placed with an ambiguous place name, or unplaced.

fields.label: Performance geography status
fields.meaning: The same for the place of performance.

fields.label: Attributed to the entity
fields.meaning: Whether Cedar attributes this transaction to the Native entity (yes) or keeps it in the file unattributed (no). Cedar's totals count attributed rows only.

fields.label: Attribution status
fields.meaning: How the attribution stands: attributed through the register, unattributed, or under review.

fields.label: Source system
fields.meaning: Which source the record came from.

fields.label: Source vintage
fields.meaning: The date stamp of the archive the row was taken from.

fields.label: Source
fields.meaning: The official page for this record, written into the file so it cites itself.

fields.label: Research note
fields.meaning: A concise factual qualification that changes how the row should be read (an uncertain closing date, an amount covering a whole joint venture, a geography that cannot be assigned precisely). Blank when nothing needs saying.
